title: [anthus-site-content] the-dominance-of-ones: 9 responsive images return 400 (% in filename)
description:
**Problem**
On https://anth.us/articles/the-dominance-of-ones/ nine responsive images 400 because the filenames contain an unescaped "%".

**Evidence**
srcset entries such as `/assets/responsive/images/benfords-law/simulated-1%-structured-deposits---daily-sums-400.avif` (audit: 9 images, HTTP 400).

**Fix**
Rename the source images to remove "%" (e.g. "1pct") and update the references, or URL-encode the path as %25 in the generated srcset.

**How to verify**
Every URL in the page's srcset/src attributes returns 200: extract with `curl -sL <page> | grep -o 'srcset="[^"]*"'` and curl each.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
